audit.whatIsWrong: Difficulty framing is sound: 56.43% over 342 games, 7/10 difficulty. Lane is decided by whether you cast into Rebuttal.
audit.why: Rebuttal (W) is 38/35/33/29/26s and both reflects projectiles and prevents her taking damage; every Brand rotation aimed into it is wasted. Solar Snare (E, 11/10.5/10/9.5/9s, 1000 range) is her only lockdown and is what makes her all-in real.
audit.corrected: Kept difficulty, re-grounded the cooldown and don't fields in Rebuttal/Solar Snare timers.

audit.whatIsWrong: Late-game spike text credited a fabricated ability, 'Reflected Radiance', for her late power.
audit.why: Mel has no such ability. Her R is Golden Eclipse (120/100/80s, global) which strikes every Overwhelm-marked enemy for damage scaling with stacks; her reflect is Rebuttal (W).
audit.corrected: spikes[3].text, whys[6], late, wants.you[1], wants.foe[1] rewritten onto Rebuttal and Golden Eclipse with real cooldowns.

audit.whatIsWrong: The decisive interaction was stated only as 'reflects your projectiles back' with no numbers, and her passive was described as a shield.
audit.why: Searing Brilliance grants bonus projectiles on her next attack after any ability and stacks Overwhelm, which Golden Eclipse cashes as a threshold kill — it is not a shield. Sear (Q) only stuns an already-ablaze target, so Conflagration (E, 625 range, point-and-click) or Pillar of Flame must land first.
audit.corrected: cooldowns, dosFull[0].d, dosFull[1].d, dontsFull[2].d, spikes[0].text rewritten with the real mechanics and timers.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns contained no digit at all.
audit.why: It is the field that holds real cooldowns; Rebuttal 38s->26s, Solar Snare 11s, Radiant Volley 10s, Pyroclasm 100s are all available from the kits.

audit.whatIsWrong: Nothing warned about the Overwhelm execute threshold or the auto-attack-reset tell.
audit.why: _missing lists both: Searing Brilliance threatens a threshold kill (track the HP number) and her combo opens with an attack reset, so the wind-up is the cue, not the ability cast.

I did not propose it because the rule requires a paired content-layer win[N] edit in the same proposal and win[N] already holds the correct value — there is no valid paired edit to write. Needs a tooling decision. Also: report[] misgenders remain in report[3].t, report[4].t and report[11].t ("his" for Mel); they are verbatim copies of tradeBad/breakdown.wave/dontsFull titles that I fixed at source, so re-run the copy after those land, or apply the same three swaps.
